identity_check: Cornerstone Robotics = Hong Kong surgical robotics maker of the Sentire system (Robot Report); Medtronic's own release names the same Sentire system and Cornerstone. Not another Cornerstone firm.

pages.title: Medtronic Announces Strategic Partnership with Cornerstone Robotics
Medtronic invests $700M in surgical partner Cornerstone Robotics

open_items: Deal is a strategic investment plus ex-US distribution rights, not a conventional priced round; equity stake not disclosed on pages read.
Founding year and website not confirmed (en.csrbtx.com is linked from the pages but unverified).

Search results mentioned a roughly $200M round in Nov 2025 (unread).
